title: mixer operation
description: Adiabatic stream mixer. Sums the inlet component flows and closes the energy balance Sum H_in = H_out (Newton-1D in T_out) for the outlet temperature. No operating parameters.

T.title: Imposed outlet temperature
T.description: Present = the mixer is ISOTHERMAL at this temperature and the duty is the result. Absent = adiabatic mixing, and the outlet temperature follows from the enthalpy balance (the normal case).
